summary.content:
Today's selection covers 79 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Brad Lightcap, a Top OpenAI Executive, Steps Down
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 59 articles published in the last 24 hours
